description: This file implements MPI-based distributed process group operations for PyTorch, including collective communication primitives like broadcast, allreduce, gather, scatter, reduce, and alltoall, with support for CUDA-aware MPI and MPI error handling.

classes.name: ProcessGroupMPI
classes.description: MPI-based implementation of a distributed process group for PyTorch, managing MPI initialization, communication, and worker thread.

classes.name: WorkMPI
classes.description: Represents an MPI collective work, providing result retrieval and error handling.

classes.name: AsyncWork
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous MPI request, supporting wait, success check, and exception handling.

methods.name: createProcessGroupMPI
methods.description: Creates a new MPI process group with specified ranks.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Performs a broadcast operation across the process group.

methods.name: allreduce
methods.description: Performs an allreduce operation across the process group.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Performs a reduce operation to a root process.

methods.name: gather
methods.description: Gathers tensors from all processes to the root.

methods.name: scatter
methods.description: Scatters tensors from the root to all processes.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a tensor to a specified rank.

methods.name: recv
methods.description: Receives a tensor from a specified rank.

methods.name: barrier
methods.description: Synchronizes all processes in the group.

methods.name: _allgather_base
methods.description: Base implementation of allgather for tensors.

methods.name: _reduce_scatter_base
methods.description: Base implementation of reduce_scatter for tensors.
